fields.label: Connector
fields.description: The Jarvis Connector this sign-in is for. Deleting the connector deletes every token held against it.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The user who signed in. Sign-in is PER USER even for a Shared connector: each user runs their own, and the broker only ever resolves the row for the impersonated user it is running as.

fields.label: Expires At
fields.description: When the access token stops working. EMPTY means the provider issued no expiry (a long-lived token), and the stored token is then used as-is and never refreshed.

fields.label: Token Type
fields.description: The token type the provider returned, recorded for diagnostics.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: The access token, stored encrypted. Never returned by any API and never written to a log; read only via get_password server-side, and sent only to the connector's own address.

fields.label: Refresh Token
fields.description: The refresh token, stored encrypted, when the provider issued one. Sent only to the sign-in service's token endpoint recorded on the MCP OAuth Client. A provider that rotates refresh tokens has the replacement stored here.

fields.label: Granted Scopes
fields.description: The permissions the provider actually granted, which may be narrower than the ones Jarvis asked for.

fields.label: Resource
fields.description: The canonical connector address this token was issued for. Checked against the connector's current address before the token is used, so re-pointing a connector at a different address can never send this token to the new one.
